description: Figure: motif counts vs composition-matched null for JIP4 and YOR019W, FDR across 24 tests, and motif positions on the pLDDT track. Also writes the evidence matrix and GO decision table CSVs.

import os, re, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

OUT = os.getcwd()
slim = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "jip4_slim_scan_disordered.csv"))
pl_j = np.load(os.path.join(OUT, "plddt_Q03361.npy"))
pl_y = np.load(os.path.join(OUT, "plddt_Q99248.npy"))

def wrap(s, n=46):
    words, lines, cur = s.split(), [], ""
    for w in words:
        if len(cur) + len(w) + 1 > n:
            lines.append(cur); cur = w
        else:
            cur = (cur + " " + w).strip()
    lines.append(cur)
    return "\n".join(lines)

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(15, 11))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 2, height_ratios=[1.15, 1.0, 1.25], hspace=0.55, wspace=0.25)

# ---- A: observed vs null motif counts, JIP4 ----
axA = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
sj = slim[slim.accession == "Q03361"].reset_index(drop=True)
y = np.arange(len(sj))
axA.barh(y, sj.n_observed, color="#4878a8", height=0.55, label="observed")
axA.errorbar(sj.null_mean, y, xerr=sj.null_sd, fmt="o", color="#c44e52", ms=4,
             lw=1.4, capsize=3, label="shuffled null (mean, SD)")
axA.set_yticks(y); axA.set_yticklabels(sj.motif, fontsize=8)
axA.invert_yaxis(); axA.set_xlabel("matches inside disordered region", fontsize=9)
axA.set_title("A  JIP4 (Q03361): motif counts vs composition-matched null\n"
              "1000 shuffles of the 626 disordered residues; no class survives FDR", fontsize=9)
axA.legend(fontsize=7, loc="lower right"); axA.tick_params(labelsize=8)

# ---- B: same for YOR019W ----
axB = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
sy = slim[slim.accession == "Q99248"].reset_index(drop=True)
axB.barh(y, sy.n_observed, color="#6aa84f", height=0.55, label="observed")
axB.errorbar(sy.null_mean, y, xerr=sy.null_sd, fmt="o", color="#c44e52", ms=4,
             lw=1.4, capsize=3, label="shuffled null (mean, SD)")
axB.set_yticks(y); axB.set_yticklabels(sy.motif, fontsize=8)
axB.invert_yaxis(); axB.set_xlabel("matches inside disordered region", fontsize=9)
axB.set_title("B  YOR019W (Q99248), WGD paralog: same scan\n"
              "482 disordered residues; also no class above null", fontsize=9)
axB.legend(fontsize=7, loc="lower right"); axB.tick_params(labelsize=8)

# ---- C: BH q-values for all 24 tests ----
axC = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :])
w = 0.38
axC.bar(y - w/2, -np.log10(sj.q_BH), w, color="#4878a8", label="JIP4 Q03361")
axC.bar(y + w/2, -np.log10(sy.q_BH), w, color="#6aa84f", label="YOR019W Q99248")
axC.axhline(-np.log10(0.05), color="#c44e52", ls="--", lw=1.2)
axC.text(len(y) - 0.4, -np.log10(0.05) + 0.02, "q = 0.05", color="#c44e52", fontsize=8, ha="right")
axC.set_xticks(y); axC.set_xticklabels(sj.motif, rotation=28, ha="right", fontsize=8)
axC.set_ylabel("-log10 BH q", fontsize=9); axC.set_ylim(0, 0.45)
axC.set_title("C  Enrichment significance, 24 tests, Benjamini-Hochberg across both proteins: "
              "0 of 24 reach q < 0.05", fontsize=9)
axC.legend(fontsize=8); axC.tick_params(labelsize=8)

# ---- D: positions of the surviving candidate matches on the pLDDT track ----
axD = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
axD.plot(np.arange(1, 877), pl_j, lw=0.7, color="#333333")
axD.axhline(70, color="#888888", ls=":", lw=1)
for lo, hi, lab in [(183, 222, ""), (270, 310, ""), (382, 487, "PF29926 ordered module"), (579, 632, "PF29925")]:
    axD.add_patch(Rectangle((lo, 0), hi - lo, 100, color="#4878a8", alpha=0.13))
    if lab:
        axD.text((lo + hi) / 2, 96, lab, ha="center", fontsize=8, color="#2a4d6e")
axD.add_patch(Rectangle((343, 0), 10, 100, color="#c44e52", alpha=0.30))
axD.text(348, 7, "(RS)5\n343-352", ha="center", fontsize=7.5, color="#8b2b2f")
for s, e, t, c in [(13, 19, "LIR?", "#e08214"), (651, 657, "LIR?", "#e08214"),
                   (46, 62, "bipartite NLS", "#7b3294")]:
    axD.annotate(t, xy=((s + e) / 2, pl_j[s - 1:e].mean()), xytext=((s + e) / 2, 88),
                 ha="center", fontsize=7.5, color=c,
                 arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=c, lw=0.9))
axD.set_xlim(0, 880); axD.set_ylim(0, 100)
axD.set_xlabel("JIP4 residue", fontsize=9); axD.set_ylabel("pLDDT", fontsize=9)
axD.set_title(wrap("D  Where the candidate motifs sit. Every match lies in low-confidence sequence and "
                   "occurs at the frequency expected from amino acid composition alone, so none of them "
                   "is evidence of a binding function.", 150), fontsize=9)
axD.tick_params(labelsize=8)
plt.show()
